name: blinkit-replica
description: Full-stack Blinkit replica with User, Admin, Vendor & Driver panels

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../user-panel && npm install && cd ../admin-panel && npm install && cd ../vendor-panel && npm install && cd ../driver-panel && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run user" "npm run admin" "npm run vendor" "npm run driver"
